lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Unknown Sovereignty fighter, this is Admiral Tarek Holt of the Free Worlds Coalition. Power down your weapons and state your intent.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: This is General Arden Vale. I've left the Sovereignty, and I'm not going back.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Vale. For ten years your name topped our threat reports. Welcome to the Coalition, General. I mean that.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: No time to settle in. A supply convoy runs the outer lanes tonight, and Sovereignty raiders are already hunting it.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: You fly escort on my wing. Those freighters carry medicine for three worlds. Keep them alive, whatever comes.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Arden. This is Isolde Varn, your Sovereign. You knelt to me once. Run to them if you like; I will bring you home in chains.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Let her come. Convoy's moving, Admiral. I'm on your wing.
